Counter check: page claims 475 shipments / 21 trading partners / 26 ports, but only 5 shipment rows were actually rendered in the free view. CRITICAL: none of the visible rows carry HS 480540 (declared) — they show 40103290 (conveyor belt), 04069000 (paneer), 87141090 (e-scooter parts), 68053000 (flap disc), 84629000 (power press). 'SHREE SHYAM INDUSTRIES' is an extremely common Indian trade name and the free view gives no address/CIN/PAN to tie these rows to the claimed proprietor POOJA SAMALIA. Slug variants tried: /shree-shyam-industries (populated), /shree-shyam-industry (empty shell), /shree-shyam-industries-pooja-samalia (empty shell).
